subject: Shiny Server definition of "R process per application"

messages.author: b1c85aa4fa464db9
messages.subject: Shiny Server definition of "R process per application"
parts:
Shiny Server is limited to a "Single R Process per Application".

Does that mean that a Shiny app running on Shiny Server (not Shiny Pro) can only be accessed by a single end user at a time?  Else, is there limit on the number of concurrent users of the same Shiny app on Shiny Server?

Thx

On Sat, Sep 27, 2014 at 1:35 AM, Nicole White <nmwhi...@gmail.com> wrote:
I created an account a while back at shinyapps.io/nicolewhite but it no longer shows up when I log in under my Google account. If I try to reclaim the account it won't allow me, as it's already taken. My app on this account is still up and running. Any ideas on how I can regain access to my account?

Thanks,

Nicole

messages.author: edbcc711cdbb3da8
messages.subject: Re: [shinyapps-users] Shiny Server definition of "R process per application"
parts:
Hi John,
You can absolutely have multiple users using a single application at the same time on Shiny Server. The single threaded nature of R means that if you have an application that takes some time to complete some computation, the other users would have to wait for that work to complete before their work starts.   
With ShinyApps.io, we do start multiple R processes and with the new subscription tiers we offer we will provide tools that give the publisher greater control over the number of R processes per application.
